granite.label: Rock level: player's room with an invisible dread, an explored room 34 steps east
granite.explanation: Original: aims at (16,1), a grid the Borg has never seen and granite in the game, with a scored danger of 0; the game puts the player at (60,31), in the same room, 9 steps from the dread and in its line of sight, regional fear there 78 (as at the start). Corrected: aims at (100,25), the first zero-danger known floor grid, and lands exactly there, 34 steps from the dread, out of its line of sight, regional fear 0.
